reason: Our architect already does the renders and it's baked into their fee, and most of our buyers come from referrals who already know us. I'm not adding a second vendor and $1,500 a plan across a big library for something we're already covered on.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows a finish, window or layout we won't build, I'm the one answering to the buyer.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it built from one of our plans at lunch, free, and matching the plans exactly, with a way to lock it to our standard options. Even then I'd likely only use it on a model home or a plan that's hard to sell.
